subject.title: plugin & m4l library
subject.subtitle: searchable inventory
subject.blurb: Everything Ableton can load on this machine — every plugin and every Max for Live device, with a link out to the product page and the manual wherever one exists. Read straight out of Live’s own plugin database and browser index, so it is what Live actually sees, not what I remember installing.
